commands.command: for f in docs/designs/*.md; do b=$(basename "$f"); case "$b" in *.en.md|README.md) continue;; esac; grep -q "(./$b)" docs/designs/README.md || echo "MISSING $b"; done; echo done
commands.details: 无 MISSING 输出：62 份中文主文档全部被 `docs/designs/README.md` 引用（审计时为 18 份缺口）。

commands.command: ls -1 docs/designs/*.md | grep -v '\.en\.md$' | grep -v 'README.md' | wc -l; ls -1 docs/designs/*.en.md | wc -l; for f in docs/designs/*.md; do b=$(basename "$f"); case "$b" in *.en.md|README.md) continue;; esac; [ -f "docs/designs/${b%.md}.en.md" ] || echo -n "$b "; done
